All trends come to an end 

Follow the trend as your friend, but don't marry them 

Your job is to find regions of invalidation so you can pay yourself for being a recipient of the trend

How you do that is on you (market structure breaks, MA cross overs etc.)

I prefer to demarcate regions by volume

I then follow things like spread, book density and positional data to try glean subtle insight into whether conditions may shift 

That is all we can do -> following trend is easy, knowing when to exit the burning building is the tough one

Take profits on first turns, keep a healthy ratio of stable and pay yourself as everyone says this time is different

Above all be optimistic as markets can remain irrational for far longer than many anticipate (don't use regions of invalidation as excuses to necessarily take the other side of the coin, but to simply pay to play) 

Your future self will thank you
